storyCards.headline: Bad Medicine: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Bon Jovi's "Bad Medicine" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Bad Medicine was released in 2001.

Album: One Wild Night: Live 1985--2001 (2001).
